description: One period of HMRC's UK property income and expenses from the loaded landlord book whose chart names the property accounts: the period's own figures, both ends inclusive; a cumulative year's running total is the same call with the period starting on 6 April. Answers the income, the expenses, the slots the book did not fill and the postings behind each figure. Refuses a period carrying both consolidated and itemised expenses.
name: derive_uk_property_period
title: Derive a UK property period
